name: A Separator-Free Obstruction with a Nonpeelable Strong Reduction
definition: Start with the certified $2318$-concept one-layer tower over the terminal cut-vertex obstruction, in its integer encoding, and adjoin the word $32769=1+2^{15}$, completing the square at zero in directions $0$ and $15$.
parameters: The resulting family has $2319$ concepts on $27$ active coordinates. Its distinguished layer coordinate is $26$, and its strong $26$-projection has $1158$ concepts.
properties: The added vertex is a degree-two corner and the original tower is the canonical graph three-core. The added shattered pair joins the two components left after deleting coordinate $26$ from the core crossing graph. Hence the enlarged crossing graph is two-connected and the family has neither a cut vertex nor a separating edge, although coordinate $26$ remains universal and its strong projection is the same nonpeelable terminal cut-vertex obstruction. Every proper elementary pc-minor peels.
